rumble.gym.idle.wait: The Hall is yours to explore. Come back when you're ready to challenge this Gym.
rumble.gym.idle.gym_leader_wait: Show me what you've learned from my Gym Trainers, and then we'll battle.
rumble.gym.idle.keep_going: You earned that win. Keep going; the next challenge is waiting for you.
rumble.gym.idle.hall_cleared: I hear you earned our Badge. Keep taking good care of your team!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.idle.badges: Good to see you, %s! Try a new team before your next Gym challenge. You might surprise yourself.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.idle.mega: Welcome back, %s! The Mega Simulator is ready whenever you want to test a new partner.
rumble.may_anklet.charging: Charges over time. When fully charged, it can summon Terapagos.
rumble.may_anklet.ready: May's Anklet is fully charged. Hold it and use it to summon Terapagos.
rumble.may_anklet.summon: Use to consume the anklet and summon Terapagos.
rumble.mega.training.title: Mega Evolution Special Training
rumble.mega.training.description: Craft a Mega device, win a Mega Stone in the simulator, and practice Mega Evolution with May.
rumble.mega.training.phase.craft_device: Craft a Mega device using a Key Stone
rumble.mega.training.phase.battle_may: Talk to May and win the training battle
rumble.mega.training.phase.farewell: Return to May in the center of the Hall
rumble.mega.training.ask: %s, did you find a Mega Stone?
rumble.mega.training.explain: Great! Let's try Mega Evolution in a real battle!
rumble.mega.training.craft_hint: Use the Key Stone I gave you to craft a Mega device first!
rumble.mega.training.trial_hint: Win a simulator challenge to earn its Mega Stone!
rumble.mega.training.equip_device: Hold a Mega device or equip one in an accessory slot first.
rumble.mega.training.equip_stone: Give a matching Mega Stone to a Pokémon in your party that hasn't fainted.
rumble.mega.training.congrats: No wonder Dad speaks so highly of you! You picked up Mega Evolution in no time.
rumble.mega.training.goodbye: I'd better get back to filling out the Pokédex for Dad. See you around, %s!
rumble.prologue.lesson.mega_item.title: Awaken Your Mega Stone
rumble.prologue.lesson.mega_item: Press %s to use your Pokémon's held item and trigger Mega Evolution.
rumble.prologue.lesson.mega_battle.title: May's Training Battle
rumble.prologue.lesson.mega_battle: You did it! Each Trainer gets one Mega Evolution per battle. Now let's battle!
rumble.mega.simulator.title: Training Simulator
rumble.mega.sms.hello: Hey! Are you the new Trainer Dad told me about?
rumble.mega.sms.name: I'm May, Professor P1nero's daughter.
rumble.mega.sms.daughter: I didn't know the professor had a daughter.
rumble.mega.sms.keystone: I just brought Dad a Key Stone for Mega Evolution. We're waiting for you in the center of the Hall. Come on over!
rumble.mega.intro.objective: Meet May in the center of the Hall
rumble.mega.intro.family: %s, this is my daughter, May. She's helping me fill out the Pokédex. She went looking for Key Stones in the Overworld, so I asked her to bring one back for you.
rumble.mega.intro.explain: Use a Key Stone to craft a Mega accessory. With the accessory and a matching Mega Stone, you can Mega Evolve in battle!
rumble.mega.intro.simulator: Mega Stones aren't easy to come by. Luckily, I've just built a Mega simulator. Help me test it and I'll reward you with Mega Stones. Go give it a try!
rumble.combat.trainer_attack_blocked: Trainers must battle fair and square!
rumble.combat.turn_based_disabled: This pack uses real-time combat. Aim at a wild Pokémon and use Send Out / Battle to challenge it.
rumble.phone.locked: You need a phone and the matching SD card to use %s.
rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.title: Open Pokémon Summary and Item Slots
rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.summary: View a party member and its item slots.
rumble.guide.pokemon_inventory.body: Select a party member, then press %1$s to open its summary. In real-time combat, press %2$s for the controlled Pokémon. The item slot below the portrait displays the held item or cosmetic.
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.title: Change Pokémon Moves
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.summary: Put learned moves into the four combat slots.
rumble.guide.pokemon_moves.body: Press %s and open the Moves tab. Select a move and use its swap button, then choose a learned move from the list. Real-time combat uses these four slots in order.
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.title: Real-Time Combat
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.summary: Challenge a wild Pokémon, then move, lock on and use moves.
rumble.guide.realtime_combat.body: Aim at a wild Pokémon and press %1$s to start a real-time battle. Use your movement and jump controls to reposition. Tap %2$s for a basic attack or hold it, then release for a heavy attack. Press %3$s to dodge and %4$s to lock on. Hold %10$s to guard, or press it just before the hit for a perfect guard. Use %6$s / %7$s / %8$s / %9$s for moves. Press %5$s to switch between following and direct control. A defeated catchable wild Pokémon is stunned for 30 seconds. Leave direct control and throw a Poké Ball before time runs out. If it breaks free, the timer resets.
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.title: Give a Held Item
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.summary: Give your deployed partner a battle item.
rumble.guide.pokemon_held_items.body: If you are controlling your partner, press %1$s to leave it deployed. Hold the item in your main hand, look at your partner, and hold %2$s while pressing %3$s. Choose Give Held Item from the interaction wheel. Held items and cosmetics use different slots.
rumble.guide.effort_values.title: EV Training
rumble.guide.effort_values.summary: Earn and assign effort values to train your partner's strengths.
rumble.guide.effort_values.body: Press %s to open your partner's summary, then go to Stats and choose EVs. A Pokémon can have up to 252 EVs in one stat and 510 total. Defeating wild Pokémon in real-time combat earns points. A held Power item adds 8 points per knockout. Select a stat on the EV tab and use the slider to assign points from your pool. Vitamins and feathers increase specific stats directly. A Fresh-Start Mochi clears a Pokémon's assigned EVs.
rumble.bank_prices.title: Recycling Prices
rumble.bank_prices.bulk_tip: Recycle only checked items from your backpack and cloud storage.
rumble.bank_prices.unavailable: Return to the professor to recycle items.
rumble.bank_prices.status.changed: Inventory changed. Review the new estimate.
rumble.bank_prices.status.nothing: No selected items in your backpack or cloud storage.
rumble.bank_prices.status.stale: Quote expired. Request a new estimate.
rumble.guide.cloud_storage.title: Cloud Storage
rumble.guide.cloud_storage.summary: Access your personal Beyond Dimensions network.
rumble.guide.cloud_storage.body: Open Cloud Storage on your phone or press %s. Move items from your backpack into the network and use the search box to find them later. After the professor opens his shop, Sell → Prices also lets you recycle eligible items from your backpack and your own primary network in one transaction.
rumble.prologue.title: Prologue: The First Spark
rumble.prologue.description: Meet Professor P1nero in Gym Plaza and take your first steps as a Trainer with your new Pokémon partner.
rumble.prologue.arena.description: A private introduction to real-time battles.
rumble.prologue.transfer_failed: The arena link was interrupted. Talk to the Professor to try again.
rumble.prologue.phase.welcome.objective: Approach Professor P1nero and press %s to talk
rumble.prologue.phase.briefing.objective: Hear the Professor’s briefing; press %s to resume the conversation
rumble.prologue.phase.drills.objective: Complete the Professor’s real-time battle drills with your partner
rumble.prologue.phase.spar.objective: Defeat Pikachu in a real-time practice battle
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_1: Hey! Wait a second! Who are you?
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_3: Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_5: People call me the Pokémon Professor.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_6: This world is home to amazing creatures called Pokémon.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_7: Some people keep them as pets.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_8: Others team up with them in battle…
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_9: As for me, I study Pokémon for a living.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.intro_bonds: Lately, I've been studying the bond between Trainers and their Pokémon here in the Hall of Trials, and helping new Trainers get started.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.name: So, what’s your name?
rumble.prologue.dialogue.trainer: All right! From today on, you’re a Pokémon Trainer!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.realtime: Things work a little differently here. Pokémon battles aren’t turn-based—they happen in real time!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.choose: %s, it’s time to choose your first partner!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.choose_again: Take another look. Which Pokémon will be your first partner?
rumble.prologue.dialogue.briefing: All right, %s! I bet you can’t wait to battle. Let’s head into the simulator!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.retry: The simulator is ready again, %s. Let’s give it another go when you’re ready!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.done: Nicely done, %s! Remember: watch your opponent and find the right moment to act with your partner.
rumble.prologue.lesson.challenge.title: 01 / Start a battle
rumble.prologue.lesson.challenge: Aim at Pikachu and press %s to send out your partner and enter real-time combat.
rumble.prologue.lesson.mode_exit.title: 02 / Step Out of Battle
rumble.prologue.lesson.mode_exit: Press %s to leave real-time battle. Your partner will stay out with you.
rumble.prologue.lesson.mode_reenter: Press %s again to re-enter real-time battle with your partner.
rumble.prologue.lesson.movement.title: 04 / Get moving
rumble.prologue.lesson.movement: Move with %1$s and jump with %2$s. Travel a few paces, then land.
rumble.prologue.lesson.lock.title: 05 / Lock on
rumble.prologue.lesson.lock: Look toward Pikachu and press %s to lock on. Keep it in view as you move.
rumble.prologue.lesson.attack.title: 06 / Quick strike
rumble.prologue.lesson.attack: Aim at Pikachu and tap %s for a basic attack.
rumble.prologue.lesson.heavy.title: 07 / Charged strike
rumble.prologue.lesson.heavy: Hold %s to charge, then release when you see the charge effect.
rumble.prologue.lesson.guard.title: 08 / Read the attack
rumble.prologue.lesson.guard: Watch Pikachu charge up. Hold %s as the bolt reaches your partner. A miss won’t count.
rumble.prologue.lesson.parry.title: 09 / Perfect guard
rumble.prologue.lesson.parry: Keep your guard down this time. Press %s just before the bolt hits to block all the damage!
rumble.prologue.lesson.parry.retry: Regular block. Release guard, then press it again just before the next bolt hits.
rumble.prologue.lesson.move.title: 10 / Partner’s moves
rumble.prologue.lesson.move: Use one of the equipped move bindings (%s) to unleash your partner’s move.
rumble.prologue.lesson.spar.title: Sparring / Pikachu’s Trial
rumble.prologue.lesson.spar: All controls are unlocked. Put what you learned to use and defeat Pikachu!
rumble.prologue.lesson.clear.title: Professor P1nero
rumble.prologue.lesson.clear: Nicely done. You and your partner are ready for the real thing. Let’s head back.
rumble.growth.level.title: Pokémon Level Milestones
rumble.growth.level.description: Raise Pokémon in your party or PC Boxes. Milestone rewards are granted automatically.
rumble.growth.pokedex.title: Pokédex Collection Path
rumble.growth.pokedex.description: Catch different species. Milestone rewards are granted automatically.
rumble.growth.badges.title: Badge Collection Path
rumble.growth.badges.description: Collect Gym Badges. Milestone rewards are granted automatically.
rumble.first_badge.title: Your First Badge
rumble.first_badge.objective: Return to the Hall of Trials and press %s to talk to Professor P1nero.
rumble.first_badge.my_badge: Professor, I earned my first Badge!
rumble.first_badge.praise: Nicely done! Looks like you've got the hang of battling.
rumble.first_badge.box: A Badge Box just came in. It's yours!
rumble.first_badge.stock: Oh, I just stocked some new supplies. Care to take a look?
rumble.first_badge.sms: %s, come by when you can! A new shipment of supplies just arrived!
rumble.restock.title: The Professor's Restock Request
rumble.restock.description: The professor is running low on Tumblestones. Find out what he needs at the Hall of Trials.
rumble.restock.objective.find_tumbleston: Find any Tumblestone in an Overworld cave and bring one to the professor.
rumble.restock.objective.rocket_battle: Talk to the professor and defeat Jessie and James.
rumble.restock.explain: They're essential for crafting ancient Poké Balls. I'm running low. Could you gather some in the Overworld?
rumble.restock.location: Tumblestones are widespread. Look for clusters on the floor of an Overworld cave!
rumble.restock.accepted: Just bring me one stone. Any kind will do.
rumble.restock.offer: How's the search for Tumblestones coming along?
rumble.restock.jessie_stop: Hold it right there! Hand over that Tumblestone!
rumble.restock.jessie_2: To protect the world from devastation!
rumble.restock.james_2: To unite all peoples within our nation!
rumble.restock.jessie_3: To denounce the evils of truth and love!
rumble.restock.james_3: To extend our reach to the stars above!
rumble.restock.duo_motto: Team Rocket blasts off at the speed of light! Surrender now, or prepare to fight!
rumble.restock.thanks: That was close, %s! Good thing you were here.
rumble.restock.ball: Back to business. Thank you for finding such a fine Tumblestone. I'd like you to have this Origin Ball!
rumble.restock.tools: Oh, and some training supplies just came in. Take a set with you!
rumble.restock.tools_received: (One of each of the six Power items)
rumble.shop.title: Professor P1nero's Supplies
rumble.prologue.phase.farewell.objective: Find Professor P1nero in the Hall of Trials and press %s to talk
rumble.prologue.dialogue.farewell: All right, %s. Your next goal is to become a Rumble Master!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.hall: There are eight Gyms in this realm. Defeat them one by one, collect all eight Badges, and you’ll become a Rumble Master!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.partners: But even the best starting partner can’t get you all the way there alone.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.overworld: We’ll have to go to the Overworld to find you some teammates!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.wild: The Overworld is teeming with wild Pokémon.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.strength: See a Pokémon you like? Try throwing a Poké Ball. If it’s hard to catch, try knocking it out in battle first!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.catch: Throw a Poké Ball while it’s stunned and you’ll have a better chance of catching it!
rumble.prologue.dialogue.depart: Here, take these Poké Balls and this Pokédex! Now head to the Overworld and assemble your team!
rumble.squad.title: Squad, Assemble!
rumble.squad.description: Head to the Overworld, catch wild Pokémon, and assemble a team of six!
rumble.squad.phase.overworld.objective: Interact with the waystone in the center of the Hall of Trials and select Overworld
rumble.squad.phase.capture.objective: Catch a wild Pokémon in the Overworld with a Poké Ball. Throw one right away, or knock the Pokémon out first and catch it while it’s stunned
rumble.squad.phase.party.objective: Fill all six slots in your active party. You can move partners from the PC
rumble.gardenia.intro: Wait, don't run off yet! That battle was a thrill, plain and simple!
rumble.gardenia.offer: A battle like that calls for a little something extra. Here, take these!
rumble.gardenia.healing: Hold the SD card and press %s to install Party Healing on your phone. Open the app to heal your team between battles!
rumble.gardenia.pasture: Set up the Virtual Pasture somewhere you can build. Press %1$s to assign Pokémon. Hold %2$s and press %1$s to collect what they've found.
rumble.gardenia.visit: Oh, and Professor P1nero has been working on something at the center of the hall. You should go see him!
rumble.guide.virtual_pasture.title: Virtual Pasture
rumble.guide.virtual_pasture.summary: Give your Pokémon a place to gather items while you explore.
rumble.guide.virtual_pasture.body: Place a Virtual Pasture in a loaded area where building is allowed. Press %1$s to assign Pokémon from your PC. They won't appear in the world. Healthy Pokémon occasionally produce items from their species' drop list. Hold %2$s and press %1$s to open the 27-slot output inventory, or put a hopper underneath to collect items automatically.
rumble.personal_dimension.briefing.title: A Rift in the Hall
rumble.personal_dimension.briefing.descr: Professor P1nero has new research to share after your win against Gardenia.
rumble.personal_dimension.space_research: Ask the professor in the Hall of Trials about his research.
rumble.personal_dimension.title: A Space of Your Own
rumble.personal_dimension.description: Help the professor open a rift to a space of your own.
Take four shattered spacetime crystals from your Cloud Storage, craft them in a 2×2 square, and bring the ingot to the professor.
rumble.personal_dimension.enter_home.obj: Use the Waystone in the Hall of Trials and select Visit Your Space.
rumble.personal_dimension.start: %s, just in time! I've been researching a way to tear open a rift and create a personal space!
rumble.personal_dimension.material: I'm missing one important material, though. I think it has something to do with your Cloud Storage…
rumble.personal_dimension.hint: When you get a chance, look through your Cloud Storage and see if you can find what I need!
rumble.personal_dimension.found: That's it! It's the last piece we need for your personal dimension!
rumble.personal_dimension.ready: All set, %s! The Waystone can take you to your personal space now. Go take a look!
rumble.personal_dimension.return: Hold %s with your Soulkey to return to where you left.
rumble.personal_dimension.key_locked: Finish the professor's personal dimension research before using a Soulkey.
rumble.waystones.locked: Finish speaking with Professor P1nero to unlock story travel.
rumble.waystones.no_safe_arrival: There’s nowhere safe to land near that destination.
rumble.guide.pokemon_evolution.title: Evolving Your Pokémon
rumble.guide.pokemon_evolution.summary: Review available evolutions and choose what your partner becomes next.
rumble.guide.pokemon_evolution.body: Select your partner in the party and press %s to open its summary. Once it meets an evolution’s requirements, open Evolve, select the evolution you want, and confirm. For some species you use an evolution item on your sent-out partner; others need a certain level or other conditions.
rumble.arena.name: Battle Arena
rumble.arena.description: A private arena for real-time Pokémon battles.
rumble.arena.challenge_hint: Invite this Trainer to a real-time singles match in the arena.
rumble.arena.invited: %s has challenged you to real-time singles.
rumble.arena.invite_unavailable: This challenge is no longer available.
rumble.arena.prepare: Press %s to send out your lead, then %s to start the real-time battle.
rumble.arena.prepare_blue: In the blue zone, press %s to send out your partner.
rumble.arena.prepare_enter: Partner ready. Press %s to begin the battle.
rumble.arena.mode_locked: You can’t leave real-time mode during the match.
rumble.arena.wait_opponent: Ready. Waiting for your opponent to send out their partner.
rumble.quest_received.title: New Quest: %s
rumble.arena.draw: The battle ended in a draw.
rumble.gym.actor.rock_1.intro: Want to meet Leader Brock? First show me whether your footing is steady! Rocks never move aside for impatient Trainers!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_1.win: That was rock-solid! You crossed the rubble without losing your rhythm.
rumble.gym.actor.rock_1.lose: Never underestimate one small stone! Hold your ground and victory will build from there.
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2a.intro: I'll sharpen our offense! Jiji, I'll leave the defense to you!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2a.win: So strength is not only hardness... our teamwork needs polishing too.
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2a.lose: Once Cranidos breaks an opening, the battle rolls like a rockslide!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2b.intro: Got it! Shieldon will hold the line. Our rocky duo won't be shaken easily!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2b.win: You dismantled our defense beautifully. This Double Battle is worth remembering!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_2b.lose: Attack and defense, fitted tight as stonework! That's the skill of a Rock-type duo!
rumble.gym.actor.grass_1.intro: Plants never hurry spring, but they catch every ray of sunlight. Come, show me your patience.
rumble.gym.actor.grass_1.win: Your rhythm was gentle, yet powerful. No wonder your Pokemon answer you.
rumble.gym.actor.grass_1.lose: The seed has taken root. Stay calm, and opportunity will sprout.
rumble.gym.actor.grass_2.intro: Hey! Photosynthesis complete and energy full! Let's have a lively battle!
rumble.gym.actor.grass_2.win: Whoa, you grow way too fast! Next time I'll grow taller than Skiddo!
rumble.gym.actor.grass_2.lose: See that? Grass facing the wind can charge all the way to the finish!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1a.intro: Great luck tonight... Ahem, tonight is perfect for a Double Battle! Don't let your shadow scare you.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1a.win: Oh, the good omen went to your side. You've got real nerve!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1a.lose: The shadows saw it for me. You hesitated for just a moment, didn't you?
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1b.intro: Shh... when the candle flickers, a guest has arrived. It already remembers your scent.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1b.win: Even a Ghost-type trick couldn't fool you. What a troublesome guest.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_1b.lose: Listen, Litwick is laughing. Next time, don't wander after every will-o'-the-wisp.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2a.intro: My whole family loves Ghost Pokemon! Ping'an, let's give this challenger a lasting memory!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2a.win: Wonderful! I'll tell my whole family about this battle when I get home.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2a.lose: Ghost Pokemon look scary, but once you know them, they're the most dependable family!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2b.intro: Relax, we'll only give you a tiny fright... probably. Duskull, ready!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2b.win: You even caught Drifloon's rhythm. Looks like you're the one safely through.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_2b.lose: Hee hee, only a scare! But you'll remember the taste of defeat clearly, won't you?
rumble.gym.actor.ice_1.intro: On an icy marathon, speed matters less than steady footing. Can you keep my pace?
rumble.gym.actor.ice_1.win: Whew... you kept up, then sprinted past at the end. Beautiful!
rumble.gym.actor.ice_1.lose: Don't rush the sprint. Enduring the cold to the finish is true strength.
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2a.intro: Once snow falls, the stage is ready! Leibi, let's show them our snow teamwork!
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2a.win: Amazing. You didn't miss a move, even in the blizzard.
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2a.lose: The snowfall has begun! Don't freeze and forget your commands on our stage!
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2b.intro: Understood! Sandslash will ride the snow. In Doubles, watch both sides!
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2b.win: You turned our own snowfall against us... what cool judgment.
rumble.gym.actor.ice_2b.lose: Watch only one direction, and Icicle Spear catches you from the other!
rumble.gym.actor.ground_1.intro: Fire veins below push the strata; the earth is never still. Brace for the tremor!
rumble.gym.actor.ground_1.win: You stood firm through the shaking... I respect that foundation.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_1.lose: Mind the changes below. Read the earth, and you can read the battle.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_2.intro: A rock on the ground is only a rock; in the right place, it's a position. Break my formation!
rumble.gym.actor.ground_2.win: Well played! You saw through every trap, position, and retreat.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_2.lose: Battle isn't only charging ahead. Secure your ground, and victory is half won.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_3.intro: Young Trainer, roads are hard to read in a sandstorm. Let's see if the wind leads you astray!
rumble.gym.actor.ground_3.win: Ha ha! Sharp eyes and fine courage! Sand can hide the road, but not your judgment.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_3.lose: Don't fight a sandstorm head-on. Follow the wind and find your chance. That's old Trainer wisdom.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_1.intro: Heat at maximum, fighting spirit ignited! My flames only burn brighter!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_1.win: What a scorching comeback! This time you brought my spirit to a boil first!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_1.lose: Whew, spicy enough? A Fire battle should burn all the way to the end!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_2.intro: One spark is enough. Catch the chance, and the whole battle catches fire!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_2.win: You snuffed out my spark. You handle openings fast.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_2.lose: See the opening? Snap, ignition! That's how a battle catches fire.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3a.intro: The sun is up! Baomi, serve our Double Battle strategy while it's hot!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3a.win: The sun still shines, yet you stopped our offense. Dazzling!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3a.lose: Sunlight, Heat Wave, and mutual cover. The temperature is just right!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3b.intro: Roger! Double firepower, double teamwork! Challenger, don't get surrounded!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3b.win: You broke through our net of fire... that was blazing!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_3b.lose: Double firepower locked on! Surrender now and spend less time roasting!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4a.intro: Speed is the breath of flame! Scorch, follow my Tailwind!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4a.win: Even Tailwind couldn't catch you... your commands move faster than flame!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4a.lose: Once we take initiative, our flames leave no room to breathe!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4b.intro: No problem! Leave the heavy hits to me. Our flames don't need tricks to blaze!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4b.win: Beautiful... you met our assault head-on and still found a counterattack.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_4b.lose: Wind feeds flame, and flame rides wind! That's Kaslana Gym's fiery Doubles!
rumble.gym.actor.dark_1.intro: Halt. Leader Piers may amuse himself as he pleases, but strangers must pass our inspection.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_1.win: ...Approved. At least you're not a suspicious braggart.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_1.lose: If you cannot pass the first line of defense, do not spoil Leader Piers's fun.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_2.intro: The family entrusted me with Leader Piers. Battle etiquette is part of my inspection.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_2.win: Proper restraint and decisive commands. I shall report honestly to the family.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_2.lose: Reckless and rude. Such a Trainer has no right to approach Leader Piers.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_3.intro: Hee hee. Leader Piers loves tricks, so we prepare beautiful traps. Guess where the first step is?
rumble.gym.actor.dark_3.win: You dismantled every one! No wonder a challenger like you interests Leader Piers.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_3.lose: You stepped in it! Dark-type battles never wear their plans on their faces.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_4.intro: Leader Piers says nothing, but the family knows he came here. Show strength that puts us at ease.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_4.win: I understand. You can protect your partners and bear the result. Please proceed.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_4.lose: Strength is not bravado. If you cannot care for your partners, we won't let you near him.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_5.intro: I am the final guard. Even if he calls us meddlesome, family duty does not yield. Show your ace.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_5.win: Splendid. You may truly give Leader Piers the battle he desires.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_5.lose: This is the end. He needs a worthy opponent, not someone propped up by rare Pokemon.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1a.intro: Circuit connected! I lay the web, Luolikong supplies output. Two-person system online!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1a.win: System overload... your commands scrambled our entire circuit.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1a.lose: Capture complete! Once caught in the web, no Pokemon outruns us!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1b.intro: Output stable! Aerial circuit ready. Challenger, withstand our combined voltage!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1b.win: You redirected the voltage. Our adaptation module needs an upgrade.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_1b.lose: Current and airflow synchronized! Our combination has no safe blind spot!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2a.intro: Beat, volume, voltage. Push them all to redline! Jackson, the show begins!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2a.win: What an encore! The applause... all right, today it belongs to you.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2a.lose: Hear that? That's victory's Boomburst! Want another song?
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2b.intro: Bass is ready. Don't blink; the next beat lands with Thunderbolt!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2b.win: You stole the rhythm... keeping judgment through the noise is impressive.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_2b.lose: Treble distracts, bass closes escape. That's our live Double Battle!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3a.intro: Grounding complete, Electric Terrain deployed! Wodefa, no carelessness in the final test!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3a.win: Data recorded: challenger output and judgment both exceeded projections.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3a.lose: Terrain stable, defenses intact. Your challenge data ends here!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3b.intro: Received! Raichu opens, the back line discharges. Let's show Volkner our maximum voltage!
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3b.win: You took even maximum voltage head-on... full marks belong to you.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_3b.lose: Energy rising, output capped! Break through this current if you want Volkner!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_leader.intro: My resolve is as hard as rock! Come on, let’s have a fair and square Pokémon battle!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_leader.lose: Heh. Rock doesn’t budge that easily. Go spend a little more time getting in sync with your Pokémon!
rumble.gym.actor.rock_leader.win: Heh… rock can be chipped away after all. The bond you share with your Pokémon is remarkable!
rumble.gym.rock.title: Rock Gym · Brock
rumble.gym.rock.description: Defeat the Rock-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Brock.
rumble.gym.actor.grass_leader.intro: Oh, what a lovely day to grow! Come on, show me how much life your Pokémon have in them!
rumble.gym.actor.grass_leader.lose: Oh dear, you’re still short on nutrients. Next time, see if you can grow an even prettier flower!
rumble.gym.actor.grass_leader.win: Wow, you pulled us up by the roots! I’m happy to lose to a Trainer with that much energy!
rumble.gym.grass.title: Grass Gym · Gardenia
rumble.gym.grass.description: Defeat the Grass-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Gardenia.
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_leader.intro: Yo! The beat is on and the ghosts are ready! Keep up with my rhythm!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_leader.lose: I kept the beat and that’s a wrap! Give your presence and your technique a little more practice!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_leader.win: Whoa, that comeback was explosive! The stage is yours. You’re today’s MVP!
rumble.gym.ghost.title: Ghost Gym · Ryme
rumble.gym.ghost.description: Defeat the Ghost-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Ryme.
rumble.gym.actor.ice_leader.intro: The ice is slippery. Mind your footing. Is your passion really enough to melt my ice?
rumble.gym.actor.ice_leader.lose: Ice calls for composure and precision. You rushed. Go take some time to settle down.
rumble.gym.actor.ice_leader.win: Heh… interesting. Your passion managed to melt a corner of this solid ice.
rumble.gym.ice.title: Ice Gym · Melony
rumble.gym.ice.description: Defeat the Ice-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Melony.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_leader.intro: Hmph… you think you have what it takes to stand in front of me? Show me what you can do.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_leader.lose: Is that all? What a waste of time. I have no reason to remember the weak.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_leader.win: …Well done. You surprised me with that strength. Next time, I won’t hold back!
rumble.gym.ground.title: Ground Gym · Giovanni
rumble.gym.ground.description: Defeat the Ground-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Giovanni.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_leader.intro: Hahaha! My heart is blazing like fire! Come on, guess which move I’ll use next!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_leader.lose: Ha! Wrong answer! That’s what blazing tactics look like. Keep at it, kid!
rumble.gym.actor.fire_leader.win: Oh! You got it! Your spirit and passion are hotter than my flames!
rumble.gym.fire.title: Fire Gym · Blaine
rumble.gym.fire.description: Defeat the Fire-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Blaine.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_leader.intro: Even without Dynamax, you can have the best battle if you’re in sync. C’mon, give it everything!
rumble.gym.actor.dark_leader.lose: Ah, that’s where the tune cuts out. Your beat needs to hit heavier. You’ve still got a ways to go.
rumble.gym.actor.dark_leader.win: …Nice one! You’ve got more of a rocker’s spirit than I expected. That was a blast!
rumble.gym.dark.title: Dark Gym · Piers
rumble.gym.dark.description: Defeat the Dark-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Piers.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_leader.intro: Hah… I hope you can really get me fired up. Try not to bore me.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_leader.lose: Sigh… still not enough excitement. This little spark won’t get a rusty gear like me turning.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_leader.win: Hahaha! That’s the feeling! All those sparks finally woke me up!
rumble.gym.electric.title: Electric Gym · Volkner
rumble.gym.electric.description: Defeat the Electric-type Gym Trainers to earn a battle with Volkner.
rumble.gym.locked: Let’s come back and explore this area later!
rumble.gym.stage.arrive.objective: Follow the waypoint to the Gym entrance.
rumble.gym.actor.rock_leader.rematch: You've broken through rock before. Show me how hard you've honed that resolve since then.
rumble.gym.actor.grass_leader.rematch: Back with some new growth? Let's battle and see what your partners have blossomed into!
rumble.gym.actor.ghost_leader.rematch: You want an encore? All right! Last time you stole the show. Let's see who owns the stage tonight!
rumble.gym.actor.ice_leader.rematch: Back on the ice, are you? Good. I won't let you skate through so easily this time.
rumble.gym.actor.ground_leader.rematch: So you dare stand before me again. Good. Show me how much stronger you've become.
rumble.gym.actor.fire_leader.rematch: Ha! One right answer isn't enough! Next question: how hot can my flames burn?
rumble.gym.actor.dark_leader.rematch: You want an encore? All right. Show me your best rhythm.
rumble.gym.actor.electric_leader.rematch: I remember that spark from last time. Come on. I'm going all out from the start.
rumble.gym.leader_wait: Defeat every Trainer in this Gym, then come challenge me.

rumble.safari.reassure: Oh, don’t make that face. There’s no shame in losing to me.
rumble.safari.praise: Still, that last move was beautifully done.
rumble.safari.offer: Here. I want you to have this Technical Machine.
rumble.safari.teach: Send out your Pokémon and use the TM on it. If it’s compatible, it can learn Ice Beam.
rumble.safari.bench: If all four move slots are full, open its summary and equip Ice Beam from the move list.
rumble.safari.briefing: Return to the Trial Hall and talk to Professor P1nero.
rumble.safari.sms: %s, the League approved my Safari Zone for the simulator. Come back and check it out!
rumble.safari.welcome: %s, the League approved the Safari Zone for the simulator. Want to try it?
rumble.safari.rules: You’ll have a limited time to look for Pokémon that are hard to find elsewhere. You’ll receive Safari Balls, bait, and mud balls. Keep an eye on the timer!
rumble.safari.fee: There’s a Poké Dollar entry fee to help maintain the Safari Zone.
rumble.safari.title: Safari Zone
rumble.safari.description: Enter the Safari Zone through the Trial Hall simulator and catch a Pokémon.
rumble.safari.enter: Enter the Safari Zone through the simulator.
rumble.safari.capture: Catch any Pokémon in the Safari Zone.
rumble.merchant.objective: Bring the wandering merchant a Sinister Tea. Tea from your inventory or cloud storage counts.
rumble.merchant.thirsty: I’m parched! If only I had something to drink.
rumble.merchant.introduce: I’m a wandering merchant. Somehow my travels brought me here. Young Trainer, I’d love a cup of Sinister Tea!
rumble.merchant.ready: You already have Sinister Tea? Could I have a cup?
rumble.merchant.unknown: You’ve never heard of Sinister Tea? It’s the finest drink in the world!
rumble.merchant.guide: It’s simple to make. Check the recipe in JEI for the details!
rumble.merchant.wish: I could really go for a cup of Sinister Tea!
rumble.merchant.thanks: Wow, delicious! Thank you, young Trainer!
rumble.merchant.stock: I’ve brought curios from all over. Care to take a look?
rumble.guide.technical_machines.title: Technical Machines
rumble.guide.technical_machines.summary: Teach a compatible move and equip it in an active slot.
rumble.guide.technical_machines.body: Press %1$s to send out your Pokémon. Hold the TM, aim at the Pokémon, and press %2$s. Your Pokémon must be compatible with the move. If all four slots are full, press %3$s to open its summary, choose a move to replace, and select the new move from the list.
rumble.prologue.dialogue.idle.safari: Looking for supplies, or heading to the simulator for a Safari Zone trip?

rumble.waystones.unavailable: The waystone is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
rumble.tera.title: A Mysterious Power from Paldea
rumble.tera.description: The Tera Orb can change a Pokémon’s type in battle. Bring one to Giovanni and try this power from Paldea for yourself.
rumble.tera.objective.show_orb: Craft a Tera Orb and ask Giovanni “About the Tera Orb”
rumble.tera.objective.train_tera: Bring a Tera Orb, Terastallize in Giovanni’s tutorial arena, and defeat Team Rocket
rumble.tera.objective.report_to_giovanni: Talk to Giovanni to collect your reward
rumble.tera.paldea: By the way, have you heard of a mysterious power from Paldea?
rumble.tera.show_orb: If you have a Tera Orb, show it to me.
rumble.tera.missing: No Tera Orb? Craft one first, then come see me.
rumble.tera.explain: Equip or hold the Tera Orb, then press %s in real-time combat to Terastallize your active Pokémon!
rumble.tera.check: Now, get your Tera Orb ready. Let’s see what you can do!
rumble.tera.introduce: Very well. I’ll let those two give you some practice.
rumble.tera.butch_1: Most people wouldn’t dignify that with an answer!
rumble.tera.cassidy_2: But I’ll make an exception and tell you!
rumble.tera.butch_2: To protect the world from devastation,
rumble.tera.cassidy_3: To preserve the peace of all creation,
rumble.tera.butch_3: To bring the evils of love and truth to light,
rumble.tera.cassidy_4: The witty, charming villains are ready to fight—
rumble.tera.cassidy_6: Team Rocket, racing through the cosmos!
rumble.tera.butch_5: A bright pink tomorrow is waiting for us!
rumble.tera.congrats: Not bad. It seems you’ve mastered Terastallization.
rumble.tera.farewell: Next time, I won’t hold back.
rumble.tera.need_partner: You need a Pokémon that can battle.
rumble.prologue.lesson.tera_item.title: Terastallization
rumble.prologue.lesson.tera_item: Press %s to Terastallize your active Pokémon.
rumble.prologue.lesson.tera_battle.title: Team Rocket Attacks
rumble.simulator_test.title: Come Test This!
rumble.simulator_test.description: Help Prof. P1nero test his new training simulator software.
rumble.simulator_test.objective.meet: Talk to Prof. P1nero at the center of the Trial Hall
rumble.simulator_test.objective.test: At a training terminal, open the Simulated Universe, enter the Rock Gym, then leave
rumble.simulator_test.objective.report: Return to the plaza and report to Prof. P1nero
rumble.simulator_test.welcome: %s, you’re here! Come test this for me!
rumble.simulator_test.why: Why don’t you test it yourself?
rumble.simulator_test.strong: Obviously, I’m too strong. I might crash the program.
rumble.simulator_test.poochyena: A Poochyena chased you not long ago.
rumble.simulator_test.accident: That was an accident! I forgot my Poké Balls! How was I supposed to fight a Pokémon with my bare hands?
rumble.simulator_test.warning: Don’t let your guard down. A strong Gym Leader can cover a team’s weaknesses with a pair of Pokémon of different types.
rumble.simulator_test.instructions: Use a training terminal in the plaza and select the Rock Gym in the Simulated Universe. Just go in and come back out; you don’t have to win.
rumble.simulator_test.report_1: Pretty good, right? I wrote this software after seeing a game May has been playing.
rumble.simulator_test.report_2: Defeat simulated Trainers and your Pokémon gain real battle experience.
rumble.simulator_test.report_3: And I’ll pay you real money for the battle data.
rumble.simulator_test.report_4: One more thing: every win makes the opponent stronger next time!
rumble.simulator_test.reward: So that’s the reward you meant…
rumble.simulator_test.pp_max: Uh… fine, take this PP Max too! Keep testing while I get back to my research!
rumble.simulator_test.sms_hello: %s, I just wrote some new software and need a tester.
rumble.simulator_test.sms_test: Come test my simulated uni… I mean, Training Simulator. I’ll pay you.
rumble.simulator_test.sms_software: It’s new training software that collects real battle data. You can challenge virtual Gyms or even take on the League Champion! Anyway, come test it!
rumble.simulator_test.sms_later: I’ll take a look when I have time
rumble.guide.mega_evolution.title: Mega Evolution
rumble.guide.mega_evolution.summary: Mega Evolve a Pokémon temporarily during real-time combat.
rumble.guide.mega_evolution.body: Equip or hold a Mega device containing a Key Stone and give your Pokémon its compatible Mega Stone. In real-time combat, press %1$s shown by the stone beside your moves and wait for the transformation. Rayquaza needs to know Dragon Ascent. In an instance, each Trainer can Mega Evolve once per match.
rumble.guide.terastallization.title: Terastallization & Tera Shards
rumble.guide.terastallization.summary: Use the Tera Orb in real-time combat or change a Pokémon’s Tera Type with shards.
rumble.guide.terastallization.body: Equip or hold a Tera Orb. In real-time combat, press %1$s shown beside your moves to Terastallize your active Pokémon. A non-Stellar Tera Type changes its defensive typing and boosts matching moves; original types keep their same-type bonus. Each Trainer has one Tera slot per instance. To change a Pokémon’s Tera Type permanently, leave real-time combat, send it out, and press %2$s on it while holding enough matching shards (50 by default). Store spare shards in a Tera Pouch.
rumble.guide.training_simulator.title: Training Terminal: Simulated Universe
rumble.guide.training_simulator.summary: Use either training terminal in the Trial Hall plaza to challenge virtual Gyms.
rumble.guide.training_simulator.body: Press %1$s on a training terminal in the central plaza. Choose Simulated Universe from the horizontal icons, then select a virtual Gym. Speak to a Trainer inside to start a real-time arena match. Come Test This! only requires entering the Rock Gym and leaving the simulation. Return any time; opponents grow stronger after you defeat them.
